feat.name: Aberrant Dragonmark
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Aberrant Fortitude
entries: When you fail a Constitution saving throw, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the save, potentially turning the failure into a success. Once you've used this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Aberrant Magic
entries: You know one {@filter cantrip of your choice from the Sorcerer spell list|spells|level=0|class=Sorcerer}. Also, choose a level 1 spell from that spell list. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

entries.name: Aberrant Surge
entries: When you cast the level 1 spell from this feat, you can expend one of your {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} and roll it. If you roll an even number, you gain a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the number rolled. If you roll an odd number, one creature within 30 feet of you (not including you) takes Force damage equal to the number rolled. If no other creatures are in range, you take the damage.

feat.name: Aberrant Dragonmark
entries: You have manifested an aberrant dragonmark. Determine its appearance and the flaw associated with it. You gain the following benefits:

items: You learn a {@filter cantrip of your choice from the sorcerer spell list|spells|level=0|class=Sorcerer}. In addition, choose a {@filter 1st-level spell from the sorcerer spell list|spells|level=1|class=Sorcerer}. You learn that spell and can cast it through your mark. Once you cast it, you must finish a short or long rest before you can cast it again through the mark. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

When you cast the 1st-level spell through your mark, you can expend one of your Hit Dice and roll it. If you roll an even number, you gain a number of temporary hit points equal to the number rolled. If you roll an odd number, one random creature within 30 feet of you (not including you) takes force damage equal to the number rolled. If no other creatures are in range, you take the damage.

entries: You also develop a random flaw from the Aberrant Dragonmark Flaws table.

entries.caption: Aberrant Dragonmark Flaws
rows: Your mark is a source of constant physical pain.
Your mark whispers to you. Its meaning can be unclear.
When you're stressed, the mark hisses audibly.
The skin around the mark is burned, scaly, or withered.
You have a mood swing any time you use your mark.
Your looks change slightly whenever you use the mark.
You have horrific nightmares after you use your mark.

entries.name: Option: Greater Aberrant Powers
entries: At the DM's option, a character who has the Aberrant Dragonmark feat has a chance of manifesting greater power. Upon reaching 10th level, such a character has a {@chance 10} chance of gaining an {@filter epic boon|rewards|type=boon} from among the options in chapter 7 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}. If the character fails to gain a boon, they have a {@chance 10} chance the next time they gain a level.

If the character gains a boon, the DM chooses it or determines it randomly. The character also permanently loses one of their Hit Dice, and their hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to a roll of that die plus their Constitution modifier (minimum reduction of 1). This reduction can't be reversed by any means.

feat.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: 選擇一項屬性值提升 2，或選擇兩項屬性值各提升 1。此專長無法使屬性值超過 20。

entries.name: Repeatable
entries: 你可以多次選取此專長。

feat.name: Actor
entries: 精通於模仿和戲劇表演，讓你獲得下列好處：

items: 當你試圖將自己裝扮成另一個人時，你的魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}）和魅力（{@skill Performance||表演}）檢定獲得優勢。
你可以模仿另一個人的口音或其他生物發出的聲音。你必須聽過被模仿者說話或發聲至少1分鐘。一次與你的魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}）檢定對抗成功的睿知（{@skill Insight||察言觀色}），可以讓聆聽者辨識出這個聲音效果是假的。

feat.name: Actor
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Impersonation
entries: 當你偽裝成某個真實或虛構的人物時，你在說服他人你就是那個人的魅力（{@skill Deception|XPHB|欺瞞}或{@skill Performance|XPHB|表演}）檢定上具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}。

entries.name: Mimicry
entries: 你能模仿其他生物的聲音，包括說話聲。聽見模仿的生物必須通過一次感知（{@skill Insight|XPHB|察言觀色}）檢定才能察覺這是偽造的（{@dc 8} + 你的魅力調整值 + 你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}）。

feat.name: Adept of the Black Robes

feat: initiate of high sorcery|dsotdq|initiate of high sorcery (nuitari)

entries: You chose the moon Nuitari to influence your magic, and your ambition and loyalty to the Order of the Black Robes have been recognized, granting you these benefits:

items.name: Ambitious Magic
entries: You learn one 2nd-level spell of your choice. The {@filter 2nd-level spell|spells|level=2|school=E;N} must be from the enchantment or necromancy school of magic. You can cast this feat's 2nd-level spell without a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast this spell using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spell's spellcasting ability is the one chosen when you gained the {@feat Initiate of High Sorcery|DSotDQ} feat.

items.name: Life Channel
entries: You can channel your life force into the power of your magic. When a creature you can see within 60 feet of you fails a saving throw against a spell that deals damage that you cast, you can expend a number of Hit Dice equal to the level of the spell. Roll the expended Hit Dice and add them together. The damage that the creature takes increases by an amount equal to that total.

feat.name: Adept of the Red Robes

feat: initiate of high sorcery|dsotdq|initiate of high sorcery (lunitari)

entries: You chose the moon Lunitari to influence your magic, and your dedication to maintaining the balance between all things has been recognized by the Order of the Red Robes, granting you these benefits:

items.name: Insightful Magic
entries: You learn one 2nd-level spell of your choice. The {@filter 2nd-level spell|spells|level=2|school=I;T} must be from the illusion or transmutation school of magic. You can cast this feat's 2nd-level spell without a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast this spell using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spell's spellcasting ability is the one chosen when you gained the {@feat Initiate of High Sorcery|DSotDQ} feat.

items.name: Magical Balance
entries: When you make an attack roll or an ability check and roll a 9 or lower on the {@dice d20}, you can balance fate and treat the roll as a 10. You can balance fate in this way a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Adept of the White Robes

feat: initiate of high sorcery|dsotdq|initiate of high sorcery (solinari)

entries: You chose the moon Solinari to influence your magic, and your oath to use magic to make the world a better place has been recognized by the Order of the White Robes, granting you these benefits:

items.name: Protective Magic
entries: You learn one 2nd-level spell of your choice. The {@filter 2nd-level spell|spells|level=2|school=A;D} must be from the abjuration or divination school of magic. You can cast this feat's 2nd-level spell without a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast this spell using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spell's spellcasting ability is the one chosen when you gained the {@feat Initiate of High Sorcery|DSotDQ} feat.

items.name: Protective Ward
entries: When you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of you takes damage, you can use your reaction to expend a spell slot and weave protective magic around the target. Roll a number of d6s equal to the level of the spell slot expended and reduce the damage the target takes by the total rolled on those dice + your spellcasting ability modifier.

feat.name: Agent of Order

feat: scion of the outer planes|sato|scion of the outer planes (lawful outer plane)

entries: You can channel cosmic forces of order to gain these benefits:

items.name: Stasis Strike
entries: Once per turn, when you damage a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself, you can deal an extra {@damage 1d8} force damage to the target, and it must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + the modifier of the spellcasting ability you chose for the Scion of the Outer Planes feat) as spectral bindings try to ensnare it. On a successful save, the target escapes. On a failed save, the target has the restrained condition until the start of your next turn. These bindings manifest as chains or some other symbol of stasis. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Alert
entries: 經常對危機保持警惕，讓你獲得下列好處：

items: 你的先攻獲得+5加值。
當你意識清醒時不會被突襲。
其他生物對你進行的攻擊檢定並不會因為你看不到它而獲得優勢。

feat.name: Alert
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Initiative Proficiency
entries: 當你擲{@variantrule Initiative|XPHB|先攻}時，你可以將你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}加到擲骰結果上。

entries.name: Initiative Swap
entries: 在你擲{@variantrule Initiative|XPHB|先攻}後，你可以立即將你的{@variantrule Initiative|XPHB|先攻}與同一場戰鬥中一名自願盟友的{@variantrule Initiative|XPHB|先攻}交換。若你或該盟友處於{@condition Incapacitated|XPHB|無力}狀態，則無法進行此交換。

feat.name: Archery
entries: 你以遠程武器進行的攻擊檢定獲得 +2 加值。

feat.name: Artificer Initiate
entries: You've learned some of an artificer's inventiveness:

items: You learn one cantrip of your choice from the {@filter artificer spell list|spells|level=0;1|class=artificer}, and you learn one 1st-level spell of your choice from {@filter that list|spells|level=0;1|class=artificer}. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells.
You can cast this feat's 1st-level spell without a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have.

You gain proficiency with one type of {@filter artisan's tools|items|type=artisan's tools} of your choice, and you can use that type of tool as a spellcasting focus for any spell you cast that uses Intelligence as its spellcasting ability.

feat.name: Athlete
entries: 你曾經歷的大量肉體訓練，讓你獲得下列好處：

items: 當你{@condition Prone||伏地}時，起身只需要花費5呎移動速度。
攀爬不會消耗額外的移動速度。
你只需要徒步移動5呎就可以進行跳高和跳遠，而非原本的10呎。

feat.name: Athlete
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Climb Speed
entries: 你獲得等同於你{@variantrule Speed|XPHB|速度}的{@variantrule Climb Speed|XPHB|攀爬速度}。

entries.name: Hop Up
entries: 當你處於{@condition Prone|XPHB|伏地}狀態時，你只需消耗 5 呎移動即可起身。

entries.name: Jumping
entries: 你只需移動 5 呎即可進行助跑{@variantrule Long Jump|XPHB|跳遠}或{@variantrule High Jump|XPHB|跳高}。

feat.name: Baleful Scion

feat: scion of the outer planes|sato|scion of the outer planes (evil outer plane)

entries: You can channel cosmic forces of evil to gain these benefits:

items.name: Grasp of Avarice
entries: Once per turn, when you damage a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself, you can also deal necrotic damage to it. The necrotic damage equals {@damage 1d6} + your proficiency bonus, and you regain a number of hit points equal to this necrotic damage dealt. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Blessed Warrior

otherSummary.entry: 於獲得 2 級聖騎士「戰鬥風格」特性時

entries: 你學會兩道自選的{@filter 牧師戲法|spells|level=0|class=Cleric}，推薦選擇{@spell Guidance|XPHB|神導術}與{@spell Sacred Flame|XPHB|聖火術}。所選戲法對你而言視為聖騎士法術，且魅力是你施展它們的施法屬性。每當你獲得一個聖騎士等級時，你可以將其中一道戲法替換為另一道牧師戲法。

feat.name: Blind Fighting
entries: 你擁有範圍 10 呎的{@sense Blindsight|XPHB|盲視}。

feat.name: Bloodlust
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Powerful Recovery
entries: When you roll a {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you can treat any roll of 1 or 2 as a 3.

entries.name: Sanguine Feast
entries: Once per turn when you hit a {@status Bloodied|XPHB} creature that isn't a Construct or Undead with an attack roll, you can expend a {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die}, roll it, and regain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the number rolled plus your Constitution modifier.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Bomber
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Far Lobber
entries: When you use the {@action Attack|XPHB} action to throw a vial or flask, you can target an object or creature you can see within 40 feet of yourself.

entries.name: Long Shots
entries: Attacking at long range doesn't impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on your attack rolls with {@itemProperty T|XPHB|Thrown} weapons.

feat.name: Boon of Blazing Dawn
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Beloved of the Sun
entries: You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Radiant damage.

entries.name: Blazing Strike
entries: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, the damage can be Radiant or the weapon's normal damage type (your choice).

entries.name: Burst of Sunlight
entries: Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack that deals Radiant damage, you can emit {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 30-foot radius from yourself and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 30 feet until the start of your next turn. This light is sunlight.

feat.name: Boon of Bloodshed
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Killer's Fortune
entries: When an enemy you can see is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the next attack roll you make before the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Power from Pain
entries: Once per turn, when you make an attack roll while {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, you can deal extra damage to the target equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. The extra damage's type is the same as the attack's type.

feat.name: Boon of Bountiful Health
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Augmented Health
entries: When you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, increase the number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} you gain by 5.

entries.name: Superior Recuperation
entries: When you spend one or more {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you can instead use the highest number possible for each die.

feat.name: Boon of Combat Prowess
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Peerless Aim
entries: 當你的攻擊檢定未命中時，你可以改為命中。一旦使用此益處，直到你的下個回合開始前都無法再次使用。

feat.name: Boon of Communication
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cunning Speaker
entries: You don't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks to influence {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creatures.

entries.name: Gifted Interpreter
entries: You understand the literal meaning of any language you hear or see signed, and you can understand the literal meaning of any written language you see.

entries.name: Mental Communication
entries: You gain telepathy with a range of 120 feet.

feat.name: Boon of Desperate Resilience
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Defense of Body and Mind
entries: While you are {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to every damage type except Force.

feat.name: Boon of Dimensional Travel
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Blink Steps
entries: 在你執行{@action Attack|XPHB|攻擊}動作或{@action Magic|XPHB|魔法}動作後，你可以立即傳送至多 30 呎，到達一處你能看見的未被佔據空間。

feat.name: Boon of Energy Resistance
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Energy Resistances
entries: 從以下傷害類型中選擇兩種，你獲得對其的{@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|抗性}：強酸、寒冷、火焰、閃電、黯蝕、毒素、心靈、光耀或雷鳴。每當你完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}，你可以更改選擇。

entries.name: Energy Redirection
entries: 當你受到「能量抗性」益處所選類型之一的傷害時，你可以執行一個{@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|反應}，將同類型的傷害導向你 60 呎內一個你能看見、且未處於{@variantrule Cover|XPHB|全掩護}後方的生物。若你這麼做，該生物必須通過一次敏捷豁免檢定（{@dc 8} + 你的體質調整值 + 你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}），否則受到等同於 {@dice 2d12} + 你的體質調整值的傷害。

feat.name: Boon of Exquisite Radiance
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Eternal Rest
entries: Creatures you reduce to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} can't become Undead.

entries.name: Powerful Radiance
entries: When you make a damage roll that deals Radiant damage, you can instead use the highest number possible for each damage die. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Boon of Fate
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Improve Fate
entries: 當你或你 60 呎內的另一個生物在一次{@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|d20 檢定}中成功或失敗時，你可以擲 {@dice 2d4}，並將擲骰總和作為加值或減值套用到該 {@dice d20} 擲骰上。一旦使用此益處，直到你擲{@variantrule Initiative|XPHB|先攻}或完成一次{@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|短休}或{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}前都無法再次使用。

feat.name: Boon of Fluid Forms
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Shapechanger
entries: You can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to shape-shift into a Beast, Humanoid, or Monstrosity with a {@variantrule Challenge Rating|XPHB} no higher than 10. When you shape-shift, you gain a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} of the form. The shape-shifting effect lasts for 1 hour, and it ends early if you have no {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} left or if you take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to return to your true form.

Your game statistics are replaced by the stat block of the chosen form, but you retain your creature type; alignment; personality; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}; {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}; proficiencies; and ability to communicate. If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature, you retain it too. Upon shape-shifting, you determine whether your equipment drops to the ground or changes in size and shape to fit the new form while you're in it.
Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Hardy Transformation
entries: When you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} when you shape-shift, increase that number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} by 20.

feat.name: Boon of Fortitude
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Fortified Health
entries: 你的{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}上限提升 40。此外，每當你恢復{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}時，你可以額外恢復等同於你體質調整值的{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}。一旦你恢復了這些額外的{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}，直到你的下個回合開始前都無法再這麼做。

feat.name: Boon of Fortune's Favor
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Saving Throw Reroll
entries: When you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it and must use the new roll. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until the start of your next turn.

feat.name: Boon of Irresistible Offense
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Overcome Defenses
entries: 你造成的鈍擊、穿刺與揮砍傷害總是無視{@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|抗性}。

entries.name: Overwhelming Strike
entries: 當你的攻擊檢定在 {@dice d20} 上擲出 20 時，你可以對目標造成額外傷害，數值等同於此專長所提升的屬性值。額外傷害的類型與該攻擊的類型相同。

feat.name: Boon of Looming Shadows
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Shadowy Stretch
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, your reach for your Melee weapon attacks increases by 10 feet until the end of your turn.

entries.name: Dancing Silhouette
entries: You can take the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

feat.name: Boon of Misty Escape
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Gaseous Form
entries: If you drop to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} but aren't killed outright, you can instead drop to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} and cast {@spell Gaseous Form|XPHB} without expending a spell slot (no action required). When you cast this spell this way, you can target only yourself, your {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} is 20 feet, and you regain 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of your turns for the spell's duration. The spell's spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.
Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Boon of Poison Mastery
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Antitoxic
entries: You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison damage and the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Perfect Poisoner
entries: Once per turn, when you roll dice to determine Poison damage a creature takes from your attack, spell, or feature, you can instead use the highest number possible for each die.

feat.name: Boon of Recovery
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Last Stand
entries: 當你的{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}將降至 0 時，你可以改為降至 1 點{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}，並恢復等同於你{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}上限一半的{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}。一旦使用此益處，直到你完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}前都無法再次使用。

entries.name: Recover Vitality
entries: 你擁有一個由十顆 d10 組成的骰池。作為一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}，你可以消耗骰池中的骰子並擲出，恢復等同於擲骰總和的{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}。當你完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時，你會取回所有已消耗的骰子。

feat.name: Boon of Revelry
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Inspire Dance
entries: You always have the {@spell Otto's Irresistible Dance|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
When you cast the spell, it requires no spell components, and taking damage doesn't break your {@status Concentration|XPHB} on it.

entries.name: Sing Out
entries: While a creature that failed its saving throw against your {@spell Otto's Irresistible Dance|XPHB} has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition from that spell, it can't cast spells with Verbal components, and it sings delightful nonsense if it can sing.

feat.name: Boon of Siberys
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Aberrant Magic
entries: Choose a level 8 or lower spell from the {@filter Sorcerer spell list|spells|class=Sorcerer|level=0;1;2;3;4;5;6;7;8} or a spell from the Siberys Dragonmark Spells table (the table includes dragonmark suggestions if you'd like to associate a spell with one of the marks). You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot or spell components, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you gain this feat).

feat.name: Boon of Skill
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: All-Around Adept
entries: 你獲得所有技能的熟練。

entries.name: Expertise
entries: 選擇一項你尚未具有{@variantrule Expertise|XPHB|專精}的技能，你獲得該技能的{@variantrule Expertise|XPHB|專精}。

feat.name: Boon of Speed
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Escape Artist
entries: 作為一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}，你可以執行{@action Disengage|XPHB|撤離}動作，此動作同時會終止你身上的{@condition Grappled|XPHB|被擒}狀態。

entries.name: Quickness
entries: 你的{@variantrule Speed|XPHB|速度}提升 30 呎。

feat.name: Boon of Spell Recall
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Free Casting
entries: 每當你使用 1–4 環法術欄位施展法術時，擲 {@dice 1d4}。若擲出的數字與該法術欄位的環階相同，則該法術欄位不會被消耗。

feat.name: Boon of Terror
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Fearless
entries: You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Flee, Fools!
entries: When a creature with the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition starts its turn within 60 feet of you, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to stoke its terror, provided you can see the creature and it isn't behind {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover}. If you do so, the creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Charisma modifier and your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}) or spend its turn moving away from you by the fastest available means. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Intimidating
entries: You gain {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB} in the {@skill Intimidation|XPHB} skill if you don't already have it. You also gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in {@skill Intimidation|XPHB}.

feat.name: Boon of the Bright Sun
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Daylight Presence
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you radiate a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} that is sunlight. If any of the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}'s area overlaps with an area of {@spell Darkness|XPHB} created by a spell, that spell is dispelled. The {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} lasts until you dismiss it (no action required), die, or have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Fortifying Light
entries: When your Daylight Presence is active, at the start of each of your turns, you and allies you can see in your Daylight Presence gain 10 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

feat.name: Boon of the Furious Storm
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Eye of the Storm
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Lightning and Thunder damage. While you are {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, you have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Lightning and Thunder damage.

entries.name: Storm's Strength
entries: Creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws against your spells that deal Lightning or Thunder damage.

feat.name: Boon of the Night Spirit
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Merge with Shadows
entries: 當你身處{@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB|微弱光照}或{@variantrule Darkness|XPHB|黑暗}之中時，你可以作為一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}使自己獲得{@condition Invisible|XPHB|隱形}狀態。在你執行一個動作、{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}或{@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|反應}後，此狀態立即結束。

entries.name: Shadowy Form
entries: 當你身處{@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB|微弱光照}或{@variantrule Darkness|XPHB|黑暗}之中時，你對心靈與光耀以外的所有傷害具有{@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|抗性}。

feat.name: Boon of the Soul Drinker
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Grave Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold damage and Necrotic damage.

entries.name: Siphon Life
entries: When an enemy within 120 feet of you is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to regain 50 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Boon of Truesight
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Truesight
entries: 你擁有範圍 60 呎的{@sense Truesight|XPHB|真實視覺}。

feat.name: Bountiful Luck
entries: 你的族人們有著非同尋常的好運氣，而你也學習過如何在看到同伴陷入困境時神秘地把好運借給他們。你也不確定你是怎麽做到的；你只是想想，它就實現了。這無疑是你受到命運眷顧的象徵！
當一個與你距離30呎內，你能看見的隊友在攻擊檢定、能力檢定、或豁免檢定的d20中骰出了1，你可以使用你的反應來讓該隊友重新擲骰。該隊友必須使用新的擲骰結果。
當你使用這個能力，直到你的下個回合結束之前，你都不能使用你的幸運種族特性。

feat.name: Cartomancer
entries: You have learned to channel your magic through a deck of cards. You can use a card deck as your spellcasting focus, and you gain the following benefits:

items.name: Card Tricks
entries: You learn the {@spell Prestidigitation} cantrip and can use it to create illusions that duplicate the effects of stage magic. When you use {@spell Prestidigitation} in this way, you can conceal the verbal and somatic components of the spell as ordinary conversation and card handling.

items.name: Hidden Ace
entries: When you finish a long rest, you can choose one spell from your class's spell list and imbue that spell into a card. The chosen spell must have a casting time of 1 action, and it must be a level for which you have spell slots. The card remains imbued with this spell for 8 hours. While the card is imbued with the spell, you can use a bonus action to flourish the card and cast the spell within. The card then immediately loses its magic.

feat.name: Charger
entries: 當你使用動作進行疾走時，你可以使用附贈動作來進行一次近戰武器攻擊或推撞一個生物。
若你直線移動至少10呎後馬上進行該附贈動作，則（若你選擇近戰攻擊且命中）該攻擊的傷害獲得+5加值，或（若你選擇推撞且成功）目標被推離你最多10呎。

feat.name: Charger
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Improved Dash
entries: 當你執行{@action Dash|XPHB|疾走}動作時，你的{@variantrule Speed|XPHB|速度}在該動作中提升 10 呎。

entries.name: Charge Attack
entries: 若你在作為{@action Attack|XPHB|攻擊}動作一部分以近戰攻擊檢定命中目標之前，立即朝該目標直線移動了至少 10 呎，選擇以下效果之一：該攻擊的傷害擲骰獲得 {@dice 1d8} 加值；或將目標推離至多 10 呎（若目標體型不超過你一級）。你在每個回合中只能使用此益處一次。

feat.name: Chef
entries: Time spent mastering the culinary arts has paid off, granting you the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with {@item cook's utensils|phb} if you don't already have it.

As part of a short rest, you can cook special food, provided you have ingredients and {@item cook's utensils|phb} on hand. You can prepare enough of this food for a number of creatures equal to 4 + your proficiency bonus. At the end of the short rest, any creature who eats the food and spends one or more Hit Dice to regain hit points regains an extra {@dice 1d8} hit points.

With one hour of work or when you finish a long rest, you can cook a number of treats equal to your proficiency bonus. These special treats last 8 hours after being made. A creature can use a bonus action to eat one of those treats to gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

feat.name: Chef
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Cook's Utensils
entries: 若你尚未熟練{@item Cook's Utensils|XPHB|廚師炊具}，你獲得其熟練。

entries.name: Replenishing Meal
entries: 作為{@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|短休}的一部分，若你手邊有食材與{@item Cook's Utensils|XPHB|廚師炊具}，你可以烹煮特製料理。你準備的料理份量足以供應數量等同於 4 + 你{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}的生物。在該{@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|短休}結束時，任何食用了此料理並消耗一顆或更多生命骰來恢復{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}的生物，會額外恢復 {@dice 1d8} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}。

entries.name: Bolstering Treats
entries: 經過 1 小時的工作，或在你完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時，若你手邊有食材與{@item Cook's Utensils|XPHB|廚師炊具}，你可以烹製數量等同於你{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}的點心。這些特製點心在製成後可保存 8 小時。生物可以使用一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}吃下一份點心，獲得等同於你{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}的{@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB|臨時生命值}。

feat.name: Child of the Sun
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Eyes of Eirdu
entries: You and allies within 10 feet of you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws made to avoid or end the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Faerie Fire
entries: You learn the {@spell Faerie Fire|XPHB} spell. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have.
When you cast {@spell Faerie Fire|XPHB} without a spell slot using this benefit, taking damage can't break your {@status Concentration|XPHB} on the spell.

feat.name: Cloying Mists
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Arise, Fog
entries: You always have the {@spell Fog Cloud|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot, and you must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast it using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for the spell is the ability increased by this feat.

entries.name: Grasping Mist
entries: Whenever you cast {@spell Fog Cloud|XPHB}, nonmagical flames in the spell's {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} are extinguished, and creatures other than you and your allies have their {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} reduced by 5 feet while in the spell's {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}.

feat.name: Cohort of Chaos

feat: scion of the outer planes|sato|scion of the outer planes (chaotic outer plane)

entries: You can channel cosmic forces of chaos to gain these benefits:

items.name: Chaotic Flare
entries: When you roll a 1 or a 20 on an attack roll or a saving throw, the magic of chaos flows through you. Roll a d4 and consult the Chaotic Flares table to determine what happens. A flare lasts until the end of your next turn, and a new flare can't occur until after the first flare ends.

entries.caption: Chaotic Flares
rows: {@b Battle Fury.} A creature of your choice that you can see is filled with reckless fury. It has advantage on attack rolls and disadvantage on ability checks.

{@b Disruption Field.} Waves of energy ripple around you. Every creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of you, or that moves into that area for the first time on a turn, takes {@damage 1d8} force damage.

{@b Unbound.} When you move, you can use some or all of your walking speed to teleport yourself once, along with any equipment you're wearing or carrying, up to the distance used to an unoccupied space that you can see.
{@b Wailing Winds.} Winds swirl in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on you. You and any other creatures in that area have disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws.

feat.name: Cold Caster
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cantrip
entries: You learn the {@spell Ray of Frost|XPHB} cantrip. If you already know it, you learn a different Wizard cantrip of your choice. The spell's spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

entries.name: Frostbite
entries: Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack roll and deal Cold damage, you can temporarily negate the creature's defenses. The creature subtracts {@dice 1d4} from the next saving throw it makes before the end of your next turn.

feat.name: Crafter
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: 從「快速製作」表中選擇三種不同的{@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB|工匠工具}，你獲得其熟練。

entries.name: Discount
entries: 每當你購買非魔法物品時，你可獲得 20% 的折扣。

entries.name: Fast Crafting
entries: 當你完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時，若你持有與「快速製作」表中某件裝備相對應的{@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB|工匠工具}且熟練該工具，你可以製作一件該表中的裝備。該物品持續存在直到你完成下一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}，屆時它會解體。

entries.caption: 快速製作
rows: {@item Crossbow Bolt Case|XPHB|弩矢匣}、{@item Map or Scroll Case|XPHB|地圖或卷軸筒}、{@item Pouch|XPHB|囊袋}
{@item Ball Bearings|XPHB|滾珠}、{@item Bucket|XPHB|水桶}、{@item Caltrops|XPHB|鐵蒺藜}、{@item Grappling Hook|XPHB|爪鉤}、{@item Iron Pot|XPHB|鐵鍋}
{@item Bell|XPHB|鈴鐺}、{@item Shovel|XPHB|鏟子}、{@item Tinderbox|XPHB|打火匣}
{@item Basket|XPHB|籃子}、{@item Rope|XPHB|繩索}、{@item Net|XPHB|捕網}、{@item Tent|XPHB|帳篷}
{@item Club|XPHB|棍棒}、{@item Greatclub|XPHB|巨棍}、{@item Quarterstaff|XPHB|長棍}

feat.name: Crossbow Expert
entries: 多虧你在弩上投入的大量訓練，你獲得下列好處：

items: 你忽略你所熟練的弩上的裝填屬性。
處於敵對生物5呎距離內並不會讓你的遠程攻擊獲得劣勢。
當你採取攻擊動作並且以單手武器攻擊，你可以使用附贈動作以一把你持握的{@item Hand Crossbow|phb|手弩}進行攻擊。

feat.name: Crossbow Expert
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Ignore Loading
entries: 你無視{@item Hand Crossbow|XPHB|手弩}、{@item Heavy Crossbow|XPHB|重弩}與{@item Light Crossbow|XPHB|輕弩}（在此專長中統稱為弩）的{@itemProperty LD|XPHB|裝填}屬性。若你正持有其中一把，即使你沒有空出的手，也可以為其裝填彈藥。

entries.name: Firing in Melee
entries: 位於敵人 5 呎內不會使你以弩進行的攻擊檢定具有{@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB|劣勢}。

entries.name: Dual Wielding
entries: 當你進行{@itemProperty L|XPHB|輕型}屬性的額外攻擊時，若該攻擊是以具有{@itemProperty L|XPHB|輕型}屬性的弩進行，且你尚未將屬性調整值加到傷害上，你可以將屬性調整值加到該額外攻擊的傷害上。

feat.name: Crusher
entries: You are practiced in the art of crushing your enemies, granting you the following benefits:

items: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that deals bludgeoning damage, you can move it 5 feet to an unoccupied space, provided the target is no more than one size larger than you.
When you score a critical hit that deals bludgeoning damage to a creature, attack rolls against that creature are made with advantage until the start of your next turn.

feat.name: Crusher
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Push
entries: 每回合一次，當你以造成鈍擊傷害的攻擊命中一個生物時，若目標體型不超過你一級，你可以將其移動 5 呎至一處未被佔據的空間。

entries.name: Enhanced Critical
entries: 當你對一個生物造成鈍擊傷害的{@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB|重擊}時，直到你的下個回合開始前，對該生物進行的攻擊檢定具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}。

feat.name: Cult of the Dragon Initiate
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Dragon's Tongue
entries: You know Draconic. If you already know Draconic when you select this feat, you instead learn one language of your choice from the language tables in the Player's Handbook or Chapter 2 of this book.

entries.name: Dragon's Terror
entries: You can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to instill terror in a creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Wisdom modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}) or have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn. If the target succeeds on the save or when the effect ends for a target, the target is immune to this effect for 24 hours.

entries.name: Inspired by Fear
entries: When you cause a creature to have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition and you are the source of its fear, you can gain {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} if you lack it. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Defense
entries: 當你穿著輕型、中型或重型護甲時，你的{@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB|護甲等級}獲得 +1 加值。

feat.name: Defensive Duelist
entries: 當你持握一把你所熟練的靈巧武器，且另一個生物以近戰攻擊命中了你時，你可以針對此次攻擊使用你的反應將你的熟練加值加到AC上，這可能會讓該攻擊因此失手。

feat.name: Defensive Duelist
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Parry
entries: 若你正持有一把靈巧武器，而另一個生物以近戰攻擊命中你，你可以執行一個{@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|反應}，將你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}加到你的{@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB|護甲等級}上，可能使該攻擊未命中。直到你的下個回合開始前，你對近戰攻擊的 AC 都獲得此加值。

feat.name: Delicious Pain
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Toughened Flesh
entries: Immediately after you take Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage until the start of your next turn. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Divinely Favored
entries: A god chose you to carry a spark of their power.

You learn one cantrip of your choice from the {@filter cleric spell list|spells|level=0|class=cleric} and one 1st-level spell based on the alignment of your character, as specified in the Alignment Spells table below. You also learn the {@spell augury} spell.

You can cast the chosen 1st-level spell and the {@spell augury} spell without a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast either of these spells in this way again. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (choose when you select this feat).
In addition, you can use a holy symbol as a spellcasting focus for any spell you cast that uses the spellcasting ability you choose when you select this feat.

feat.name: Dragon Fear
entries: 在感到憤怒時，你散發出威懾的氣息。你獲得下列好處：

items: 你可以花費一次你噴吐武器特性的使用額度，並非噴吐出毀滅性的能量，而是發出咆嘯以強迫距離你30呎內每個你所選擇的生物進行一次感知豁免檢定（DC8+你的熟練加值+你的魅力調整值）。如果目標不能聽見或看見你，則目標將自動通過豁免。若豁免失敗，則目標將對你感到{@condition Frightened||恐懼}持續1分鐘。如果因此陷入{@condition Frightened||恐懼}的目標受到任何傷害，它可以重複進行這個豁免檢定，並在豁免成功時終止此能力對自己的效果。

feat.name: Dragon Hide
entries: 你顯而易見的鱗片和利爪讓人想起了你的龍族先祖。你獲得下列好處：

items: 你的鱗片變的堅硬。當你未穿著護甲，你可以使用13+你的敏捷調整值來算出你的AC。你可以在使用盾牌時而仍獲得這個好處。
你的指尖長出可伸縮的爪子。這對爪子是你可以用來進行徒手打擊的天生武器。如果你用它們命中目標，你造成等同於{@dice 1d4}+你的力量調整值的劈砍傷害，而非原本徒手打擊的鈍擊傷害。

feat.name: Dragonscarred
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Damage Resistance
entries: When you gain this feat, choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the chosen damage type.

entries.name: Fearsome Power
entries: When you deal damage to a creature as part of the Attack or Magic action on your turn, you can use the Dragon's Terror benefit of the Cult of the Dragon Initiate feat as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} this turn.

feat.name: Drow High Magic
entries: 你學會更多的黑暗精靈魔法。你習得{@spell Detect Magic||偵測魔法}法術並可以隨意施放它，無需消耗法術位。你也習得{@spell Levitate||浮空術}和{@spell Dispel Magic||解除魔法}，並可以各自施放一次而無需消耗法術位。你在完成一次長休後重新獲得施放這兩個法術的能力。這三個法術的施法屬性是魅力。

feat.name: Druidic Warrior

otherSummary.entry: 於獲得 2 級遊俠「戰鬥風格」特性時

entries: 你學會兩道自選的{@filter 德魯伊戲法|spells|level=0|class=druid}，推薦選擇{@spell Guidance|XPHB|神導術}與{@spell Starry Wisp|XPHB|星光微芒}。所選戲法對你而言視為遊俠法術，且感知是你施展它們的施法屬性。每當你獲得一個遊俠等級時，你可以將其中一道戲法替換為另一道德魯伊戲法。

feat.name: Dual Wielder
entries: 你精通於雙持武器作戰，獲得下列好處：

items: 當你每隻手都各持握一把近戰武器時，你的AC獲得+1加值。
即使你持握的單手近戰武器並非輕型，你仍可以進行雙武器戰鬥。
在你原本只能拔出或入鞘一把武器的時候，你可以同時拔出或入鞘二把單手武器。

feat.name: Dual Wielder
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Enhanced Dual Wielding
entries: 當你在自己的回合執行{@action Attack|XPHB|攻擊}動作並以具有{@itemProperty L|XPHB|輕型}屬性的武器攻擊時，你可以在同一回合稍後作為一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}，以另一把武器進行一次額外攻擊，該武器必須是不具{@itemProperty 2H|XPHB|雙手}屬性的近戰武器。除非屬性調整值為負，否則你不將屬性調整值加到額外攻擊的傷害上。

entries.name: Quick Draw
entries: 在你通常只能拔出或收起一把武器時，你可以改為拔出或收起兩把不具{@itemProperty 2H|XPHB|雙手}屬性的武器。

feat.name: Dueling
entries: 當你單手持有一把近戰武器且未持有其他武器時，你以該武器進行的傷害擲骰獲得 +2 加值。

feat.name: Dungeon Delver
entries: 警戒於大多地城中會發現的隱藏陷阱和密門，你獲得下列好處：

items: 你在搜尋密門時所進行的睿知（{@skill Perception||感知}）和智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定中有優勢。
你在躲避或抵抗陷阱時的豁免檢定中有優勢。
對於陷阱所造成的傷害具有抗性。
以快速步速旅行並不會對你的被動睿知（{@skill Perception||感知}）數值造成原本的-5減值。

feat.name: Durable
entries: 堅強而持久，你獲得下列好處：

items: 當你骰生命骰來恢復生命值時，每顆生命骰恢復的生命值最少等於你體質調整值的兩倍（最少為2）。

feat.name: Durable
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Defy Death
entries: 你在{@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|死亡豁免檢定}上具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}。

entries.name: Speedy Recovery
entries: 作為一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}，你可以消耗一顆{@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|生命骰}並擲出，恢復等同於擲骰結果的{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}。

feat.name: Dwarven Fortitude
entries: 你的體內流淌著矮人英雄的血脈。你獲得下列好處：

items: 每當你在戰鬥中採取{@action Dodge||閃避}動作時，你可以消耗一顆生命骰以治療你自己。骰該生命骰，加上你的體質調整值，並回復等同於其總和數值的生命值（最少為1）。

feat.name: Eldritch Adept
entries: Studying occult lore, you learn one {@filter Eldritch Invocation|optionalfeatures|Feature Type=EI} option of your choice from the warlock class. Your spellcasting ability for the invocation is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (choose when you select this feat). If the invocation has a prerequisite of any kind, you can choose that invocation only if you're a warlock who meets the prerequisite.
Whenever you gain a level, you can replace the invocation with another one from the warlock class.

feat.name: Elemental Adept
entries: 當你獲得此專長時，選擇下列一種傷害類型：酸蝕、寒冰、火焰、閃電、雷鳴。
你施放的法術忽視你所選擇傷害類型的抗性。此外，當你施放法術造成所選類型的傷害時，你可以將所有傷害骰骰出的1視為2。
你可以多次選擇獲得此專長。每次你這麼做，都必須選擇一種不同的傷害類型。

feat.name: Elemental Adept
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Energy Mastery
entries: 從以下傷害類型中選擇一種：強酸、寒冷、火焰、閃電或雷鳴。你施展的法術無視對所選類型傷害的{@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|抗性}。此外，當你為自己施展的、造成該類型傷害的法術擲傷害時，你可以將傷害骰上的任何 1 視為 2。

entries.name: Repeatable
entries: 你可以多次選取此專長，但每次都必須為「能量精通」選擇不同的傷害類型。

feat.name: Elven Accuracy
entries: 精靈的準確性是眾所周知的，尤其是精靈弓箭手和施法者。你在依賴精確度而非蠻力的攻擊中有著不可思議的準頭。你獲得下列好處：

items: 每當你在使用敏捷、智力、睿知、或魅力的攻擊檢定中具有優勢，你可以重骰其中一顆骰子一次。

feat.name: Ember of the Fire Giant

feat: strike of the giants|BGG|strike of the giants (fire strike)

entries: You've manifested the fiery combat emblematic of fire giants, granting you the following benefits:

items.name: Born of Flame
entries: You have resistance to fire damage.

items.name: Searing Ignition
entries: When you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can replace a single attack with a magical burst of flame. Each creature of your choice in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on you must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + the modifier of the ability increased by this feat). On a failed save, a creature takes fire damage equal to {@damage 1d8} + your proficiency bonus, and it has the blinded condition until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only. You can use your Searing Ignition a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus (but no more than once per turn), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Emerald Enclave Fledgling
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Speak with Animals
entries: You always have the {@spell Speak with Animals|XPHB} spell prepared and can cast it with any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). When you cast this spell as a {@variantrule Ritual|XPHB}, its duration is 8 hours.

entries.name: Tag Team
entries: When you take the {@action Help|XPHB} action, you can switch places with a willing ally within 5 feet of yourself as part of that same action. This movement doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}. You can't use this benefit if the ally has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

feat.name: Enclave Magic
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Friend to Animals
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on ability checks when taking the {@action Influence|XPHB} action with Beasts.

entries.name: Two Hearts, One Mind
entries: You always have the {@spell Beast Sense|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. When you cast it without a spell slot using this feature, it doesn't require {@status Concentration|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spell's spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

feat.name: Fade Away
entries: 你的族人在幻術系魔法上聰穎且握有獨門訣竅。你學過一種在你受到傷害時消失無蹤的魔法把戲。你獲得下列好處：

items: 緊接在你受到傷害後，你可以使用一個反應以用魔法變得{@condition Invisible||隱形}直到你的下個回合結束，或直到你攻擊、造成傷害、或強迫某人進行一次豁免檢定。一旦你使用此能力，直到你完成一次短休或長休之前都無法再使用此能力。

feat.name: Fairy Trickster
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Faerie Trod Trotter
entries: When you take the {@action Disengage|XPHB} action on your turn, {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} doesn't cost you extra movement for the rest of that turn.

entries.name: Flustering Strike
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can attempt to fluster the target. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat and your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}) or have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws until the end of your next turn.
You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Fey Teleportation
entries: 你對高等精靈傳說的研究解開了除了你的雅靈表親外，很少其他精靈擁有的精族力量。藉助於你的精類血統，你可以暫時地躍穿妖精荒野以縮短從一處到另一處的距離。你獲得下列好處：

items: 你習得說、讀、寫木族語。
你習得{@spell Misty Step||迷蹤步}法術，並可以無需消耗法術位施放一次。你在完成一次短休或長休後重新獲得施放此法術的能力。這個法術的施法屬性是智力。

feat.name: Fey Touched
entries: Your exposure to the Feywild's magic has changed you, granting you the following benefits:

items: You learn the {@spell misty step} spell and one {@filter 1st-level spell|spells|level=1|school=E;D} of your choice. The {@filter 1st-level spell|spells|level=1|school=E;D} must be from the divination or enchantment school of magic. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either of these spells in this way, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells' spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

feat.name: Fey-Touched
entries: 你接觸了妖精荒野的魔法，使你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Fey Magic
entries: 選擇一道{@filter 預言系或惑控系的 1 環法術|spells|level=1|school=E;D}。你總是準備著該法術與{@spell Misty Step|XPHB|迷蹤步}。你可以不消耗法術欄位施展這兩道法術。一旦你以此方式施展其中一道法術，直到你完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}前都無法再以此方式施展該法術。你也可以使用你擁有的適當環階法術欄位施展這些法術。這些法術的施法屬性為此專長所提升的屬性。

feat.name: Fighting Initiate
entries: Your martial training has helped you develop a particular style of fighting. As a result, you learn one {@filter Fighting Style|optionalfeatures|Feature Type=FS:F} option of your choice from the fighter class. If you already have a style, the one you choose must be different.
Whenever you reach a level that grants the Ability Score Improvement feature, you can replace this feat's fighting style with another one from the fighter class that you don't have.

feat.name: Flames of Phlegethos
entries: 你學會呼喚地獄之火以服從你的命令。你獲得下列好處：

items: 當你為你所施放的法術擲骰決定火焰傷害時，你可以重骰任何你在火焰傷害骰中骰出的1，但你必須使用新的擲骰結果，即使其結果仍然是1。
每當你施放一個造成火焰傷害的法術時，你可以使烈焰環繞著你直到你的下個回合結束。這團烈焰不會傷害你或你的所有物，且會散發30呎範圍的明亮光照和再延伸30呎的微光光照。當這團烈焰存在時，任何距離你5呎內且以近戰攻擊命中你的生物將受到{@dice 1d4}火焰傷害。

feat.name: Fury of the Frost Giant

feat: strike of the giants|BGG|strike of the giants (frost strike)

entries: You've manifested the icy might emblematic of frost giants, granting you the following benefits:

items.name: Born of Ice
entries: You have resistance to cold damage.

items.name: Frigid Retaliation
entries: Immediately after a creature you can see within 30 feet of you hits you with an attack roll and deals damage, you can use your reaction to retaliate with a conjured blast of ice. The creature must make a Constitution saving throw (DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + the modifier of the ability increased by this feat). On a failed save, the creature takes cold damage equal to {@damage 1d8} + your proficiency bonus, and its speed is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn. You can use this reaction a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Genie Magic
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Wish Magic
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can cast a {@filter level 1 spell of your choice from the Sorcerer spell list|spells|level=1|class=Sorcerer} that has a casting time of an action. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. The spell's spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.
When you reach level 11, the spell you cast with this feat is cast as though using a level 2 spell slot.
When you reach level 17, the spell is cast as though using a level 3 spell slot.

feat.name: Gift of the Chromatic Dragon
entries: You've manifested some of the power of chromatic dragons, granting you the following benefits:

items.name: Chromatic Infusion
entries: As a bonus action, you can touch a {@filter simple or martial weapon|items|source=phb|category=basic|type=martial weapon;simple weapon} and infuse it with one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. For the next minute, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 1d4} damage of the chosen type when it hits. After you use this bonus action, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

items.name: Reactive Resistance
entries: When you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison damage, you can use your reaction to give yourself resistance to that instance of damage. You can use this reaction a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Gift of the Gem Dragon
entries: You've manifested some of the power of gem dragons, granting you the following benefits:

items.name: Telekinetic Reprisal
entries: When you take damage from a creature that is within 10 feet of you, you can use your reaction to emanate telekinetic energy. The creature that dealt damage to you must make a Strength saving throw (DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat). On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 2d8} force damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away from you. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed. You can use this reaction a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Gift of the Metallic Dragon
entries: You've manifested some of the power of metallic dragons, granting you the following benefits:

items.name: Draconic Healing
entries: You learn the {@spell cure wounds} spell. You can cast this spell without expending a spell slot. Once you cast this spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast this spell using spell slots you have. The spell's spellcasting ability is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma when you cast it with this feat (choose when you gain the feat).

items.name: Protective Wings
entries: You can manifest protective wings that can shield you or others. When you or another creature you can see within 5 feet of you is hit by an attack roll, you can use your reaction to manifest spectral wings from your back for a moment. You grant a bonus to the target's AC equal to your proficiency bonus against that attack roll, potentially causing it to miss. You can use this reaction a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Grappler
entries: 你著重磨練了如何保持近距離擒抱的技巧。你獲得下列好處：

items: 你對被你擒抱的生物所進行的攻擊檢定有優勢。
你可以使用動作嘗試壓制被你擒抱而處於{@condition Grappled||被擒}狀態的生物。若要這麼做，你需要進行另外一次擒抱檢定。若成功，則直到結束擒抱之前，你與該生物同時進入{@condition Restrained||束縛}狀態。

feat.name: Grappler
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Punch and Grab
entries: 當你在自己的回合中作為{@action Attack|XPHB|攻擊}動作的一部分以{@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|徒手打擊}命中一個生物時，你可以同時使用「傷害」與「擒抱」選項。你每回合只能使用此益處一次。

entries.name: Attack Advantage
entries: 你對被你{@condition Grappled|XPHB|被擒}的生物進行的攻擊檢定具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}。

entries.name: Fast Wrestler
entries: 若被你{@condition Grappled|XPHB|被擒}的生物體型與你相同或更小，你移動它時無需消耗額外移動。

feat.name: Great Weapon Fighting
entries: 當你以雙手持握的近戰武器進行攻擊並擲傷害時，你可以將傷害骰上的任何 1 或 2 視為 3。該武器必須具有{@itemProperty 2h|XPHB|雙手}或{@itemProperty V|XPHB|多用}屬性才能獲得此益處。

feat.name: Great Weapon Master
entries: 你學會了如何將武器重量轉化為優勢，利用其動量來增強你的打擊。你獲得下列好處：

items: 在你的回合，當你用近戰武器造成重擊、或將一名生物的生命值降至0，你可以使用附贈動作再進行一次近戰武器攻擊。
在你使用你所熟練的重型武器進行近戰攻擊之前，你可以選擇讓該次攻擊檢定承受-5的減值。若該次攻擊命中，該次攻擊的傷害+10。

feat.name: Great Weapon Master
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Heavy Weapon Mastery
entries: 當你在自己的回合中作為{@action Attack|XPHB|攻擊}動作的一部分，以具有{@itemProperty H|XPHB|重型}屬性的武器命中一個生物時，你可以使該武器對目標造成額外傷害，數值等同於你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}。

entries.name: Hew
entries: 在你以近戰武器造成{@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB|重擊}，或以近戰武器將一個生物的{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}降至 0 後，你可以立即作為一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}，以同一把武器進行一次攻擊。

feat.name: Greater Aberrant Mark
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Fortitude
entries: When you use the Aberrant Fortitude benefit of your Aberrant Dragonmark feat, you can roll {@dice 1d6} instead of {@dice 1d4}. You also now regain your use of Aberrant Fortitude whenever you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Mark of Inspiration
entries: When you cast a cantrip, you can roll one or two of your unexpended {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}. You gain a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the number rolled plus your Constitution modifier, and one creature of your choice within 30 feet of you (not including you) takes Force damage equal to the number rolled. Those dice are then expended.
You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Greater Mark of Detection
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Intuition
entries: When you use the Deductive Intuition benefit of your {@feat Mark of Detection|EFA} feat, you can roll {@dice 1d6} instead of {@dice 1d4}.

entries.name: Shared Detection
entries: When you use the Magical Detection benefit of your {@feat Mark of Detection|EFA} feat to cast {@spell See Invisibility|XPHB} without a spell slot, you can choose one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself. That creature also gains the benefits of the spell for its duration.

feat.name: Greater Mark of Finding
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Intuition
entries: When you use the Hunter's Intuition benefit of your {@feat Mark of Finding|EFA} feat, you can roll {@dice 1d6} instead of {@dice 1d4}.

entries.name: Improved Finding
entries: When you use the Finder's Magic benefit of your {@feat Mark of Finding|EFA} to cast {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB} without a spell slot, the range of the spell is doubled, and you can modify the spell so that the target can't benefit from the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition for the duration.

feat.name: Greater Mark of Handling
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Intuition
entries: When you use the Wild Intuition benefit of your {@feat Mark of Handling|EFA} feat, you can roll {@dice 1d6} instead of {@dice 1d4}.

entries.name: Improved Handling
entries: While you are mounted, immediately after you hit a target within 5 feet of your mount with a melee attack roll, your mount can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} or take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action to make one attack only (your choice).

entries.name: Subdue Animal
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you exert command over one Beast or Monstrosity you can see within 30 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Wisdom modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}) or have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Greater Mark of Healing
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Intuition
entries: When you use the Medical Intuition benefit of your {@feat Mark of Healing|EFA} feat, you can roll {@dice 1d6} instead of {@dice 1d4}.

entries.name: Improved Healing
entries: You can now use the Healing Touch benefit of your {@feat Mark of Healing|EFA} feat to cast {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB} without using a spell slot a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. Additionally, when you cast {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB} and roll dice to determine the number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} restored, you can treat any 1 or 2 on a roll as a 3.

feat.name: Greater Mark of Hospitality
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Intuition
entries: When you use the Ever Hospitable benefit of your {@feat Mark of Hospitality|EFA} feat, you can roll {@dice 1d6} instead of {@dice 1d4}.

entries.name: Improved Hospitality
entries: When you cast {@spell Purify Food and Drink|XPHB}, you can modify the spell so that instead of its normal effect, each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you is refreshed. Each affected creature's {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level is reduced by 1, and the creature gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} plus your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier (choose when you select this feat). Once you modify the spell with this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Greater Mark of Making
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Intuition
entries: When you use the Artisan's Intuition benefit of your {@feat Mark of Making|EFA} feat, you can roll {@dice 1d6} instead of {@dice 1d4}.

entries.name: Improved Making
entries: When you use the Spellsmith benefit of your {@feat Mark of Making|EFA} feat to cast {@spell Magic Weapon|XPHB} without a spell slot, you cast the spell as its level 3 version.

feat.name: Greater Mark of Passage
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Intuition
entries: When you use the Intuitive Motion benefit of your {@feat Mark of Passage|EFA} feat, you can roll {@dice 1d6} instead of {@dice 1d4}.

entries.name: Improved Passage
entries: When you use the Magical Passage benefit of your {@feat Mark of Passage|EFA} feat to cast {@spell Misty Step|XPHB} without a spell slot, you can also choose up to two willing creatures you can see within 30 feet of yourself before you teleport. Each target can then take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to also teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

feat.name: Greater Mark of Scribing
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Intuition
entries: When you use the Gifted Scribe benefit of your {@feat Mark of Scribing|EFA} feat, you can roll {@dice 1d6} instead of {@dice 1d4}.

entries.name: Inspired Scribing
entries: When you cast {@spell Comprehend Languages|XPHB}, you can modify the spell to encompass up to three willing creatures you can see within 30 feet of yourself. Each chosen creature also gains the benefits of the spell for the duration. In addition, for the duration of the spell, you and the chosen creatures can communicate telepathically with each other while within 1 mile of each other. Once you modify the spell with this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Greater Mark of Sentinel
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Intuition
entries: When you use the Sentinel's Intuition benefit of your {@feat Mark of Sentinel|EFA} feat, you can roll {@dice 1d6} instead of {@dice 1d4}.

entries.name: Improved Sentinel
entries: When you use the Vigilant Guardian benefit of your {@feat Mark of Sentinel|EFA} feat, you can also make one attack with a weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} as part of that same {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}.

feat.name: Greater Mark of Shadow
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Intuition
entries: When you use the Cunning Intuition benefit of your {@feat Mark of Shadow|EFA} feat, you can roll {@dice 1d6} instead of {@dice 1d4}.

entries.name: Improved Shadow
entries: When you use the Shape Shadows benefit of your {@feat Mark of Shadow|EFA} feat to cast {@spell Invisibility|XPHB} without a spell slot, you cast the spell as its level 3 version.

feat.name: Greater Mark of Storm
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Intuition
entries: When you use the Windwright's Intuition benefit of your {@feat Mark of Storm|EFA} feat, you can roll {@dice 1d6} instead of {@dice 1d4}.

entries.name: Improved Storm
entries: When you use the Storm Magic benefit of your {@feat Mark of Storm|EFA} feat to cast {@spell Gust of Wind|XPHB} without a spell slot, you also gain a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 60 feet for the duration of the spell.

feat.name: Greater Mark of Warding
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Intuition
entries: When you use the Warder's Intuition benefit of your {@feat Mark of Warding|EFA} feat, you can roll {@dice 1d6} instead of {@dice 1d4}.

entries.name: Improved Warding
entries: When a creature makes an attack roll against you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on that roll. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Guile of the Cloud Giant

feat: strike of the giants|BGG|strike of the giants (cloud strike)

entries: You've manifested the confounding magic emblematic of cloud giants, granting you the following benefits:

items.name: Cloudy Escape
entries: When a creature you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can use your reaction to give yourself resistance to that attack's damage. You then teleport to an unoccupied space that you can see within 30 feet of yourself. You can use this reaction a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Gunner
entries: You have a quick hand and keen eye when employing firearms, granting you the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with firearms (see "{@variantrule Firearms|DMG}" in the Dungeon Master's Guide).
You ignore the {@itemProperty LD|PHB|loading} property of firearms.
Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls.

feat.name: Harper Agent
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Thieves' Cant
entries: You know Thieves' Cant.

entries.name: Instrument Training
entries: You gain proficiency with a {@item Musical Instrument|XPHB} of your choice.

entries.name: Distracting Melody
entries: When you take the {@action Help|XPHB} action to assist an ally's attack roll, the enemy you're distracting can be within 30 feet of you, rather than within 5 feet of you, provided the enemy can see or hear you.

feat.name: Harper Teamwork
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Withering Wordplay
entries: When you take the {@action Help|XPHB} action to assist an ally's attack roll against an enemy, that enemy also has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the first saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Inspiring Willpower
entries: If you succeed on a saving throw to end the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} or {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition on yourself, you can choose one ally you can see within 30 feet of yourself that has the same condition. That condition immediately ends for that ally.

feat.name: Healer
entries: 你是名嫻熟的醫者，能夠快速地治療傷口並讓隊友們重返戰場。你獲得下列好處：

items: 當你使用{@item Healer's Kit|phb|醫療工具組}穩定瀕死生物的傷勢時，該生物同時恢復1點生命值。
以一個動作，你可以消耗醫療工具組的一次使用額度照顧一個生物，並恢復他{@dice 1d6+4}加上等同該生物最大生命骰數量的生命值。直到完成短休或長休之前，該生物都不能再透過此專長恢復生命值。

feat.name: Healer
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Battle Medic
entries: 若你擁有{@item Healer's Kit|XPHB|醫療工具組}，你可以消耗其一次使用次數，並作為一個{@action Utilize|XPHB|運用}動作照料你 5 呎內的一個生物。該生物可以消耗一顆{@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|生命骰}，然後由你擲出該骰子。該生物恢復等同於擲骰結果 + 你{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}的{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}。

entries.name: Healing Rerolls
entries: 每當你擲骰以決定你透過法術或此專長的「戰地醫護」益處所恢復的{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}時，若骰子擲出 1，你可以重擲該骰子，且必須使用新的結果。

feat.name: Heavily Armored
entries: 你受訓於熟練重甲的使用方法，你獲得下列好處：

items: 你獲得重甲的熟練。

feat.name: Heavily Armored
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Armor Training
entries: 你獲得重型護甲的受訓。

feat.name: Heavy Armor Master
entries: 你可以利用護甲偏斜掉對他人足以致命的攻擊。你獲得下列好處：

items: 當你穿著重甲時，非魔法武器對你造成的鈍擊、穿刺、劈砍傷害減少3點。

feat.name: Heavy Armor Master
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Damage Reduction
entries: 當你穿著重型護甲時被攻擊命中，該攻擊對你造成的所有鈍擊、穿刺與揮砍傷害都會減少等同於你{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}的數值。

feat.name: Infernal Constitution
entries: 邪魔血脈在你體內脈動，解開了一種類似某些邪魔所擁有的韌性。你獲得下列好處：

items: 你擁有對寒冰和毒素傷害的抗性。
你在對抗{@condition Poisoned||中毒}的豁免檢定中具有優勢。

feat.name: Initiate of High Sorcery
entries: You've received training from magic-users affiliated with the Mages of High Sorcery.

Choose one of the three moons of Krynn to influence your magic: the black moon, Nuitari; the red moon, Lunitari; or the white moon, Solinari. You learn one cantrip of your choice from the wizard spell list and two 1st-level spells based on the moon you choose, as specified in the Lunar Spells table.

entries.caption: Lunar Spells
rows: Choose two from {@spell dissonant whispers}, {@spell false life}, {@spell hex}, and {@spell ray of sickness}
Choose two from {@spell color spray}, {@spell disguise self}, {@spell feather fall}, and {@spell longstrider}
Choose two from {@spell comprehend languages}, {@spell detect evil and good}, {@spell protection from evil and good}, and {@spell shield}

entries: You can cast each of the chosen 1st-level spells without a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast them in this way again. You can also cast the spells using any spell slots you have.
Your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (choose when you select this feat).

feat.name: Inspiring Leader
entries: 你可以花費10分鐘來激勵你的同伴，鼓舞他們對戰鬥的信心。若你這麼做，選擇30呎內最多6個可以看到或聽到你且理解你的友善生物（可以包括你自己）。每個生物可以獲得等同你的等級加上你的魅力調整值的臨時生命值。直到完成短休或長休之前，受影響的生物都不能再透過此專長獲得臨時生命值。

feat.name: Inspiring Leader
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Bolstering Performance
entries: 當你完成一次{@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|短休}或{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時，你可以進行一場鼓舞人心的表演：演說、歌唱或舞蹈。當你這麼做時，選擇至多六名位於你 30 呎內並目睹表演的盟友（可包括你自己）。每個被選擇的生物獲得等同於你角色等級 + 你以此專長提升之屬性調整值的{@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB|臨時生命值}。

feat.name: Interception
entries: 當一個你能看見的生物以攻擊檢定命中你 5 呎內的另一個生物時，你可以執行一個{@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|反應}，使目標受到的傷害減少 {@dice 1d10} + 你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}。你必須持有一面{@item Shield|XPHB|盾牌}或一把簡易或軍用武器，才能使用此{@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|反應}。

feat.name: Keen Mind
entries: 你擁有著能以不可思議的精確度牢牢追蹤時間、方位、以及細節的大腦。你獲得下列好處：

items: 你永遠知道哪個方位是北方。
你永遠知道距離下一次日出或日落還剩下幾個小時。
你可以精準回憶起過去一個月內你曾聽到或看到的任何事物。

feat.name: Keen Mind
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Lore Knowledge
entries: 從以下技能中選擇一項：{@skill Arcana|XPHB|奧秘}、{@skill History|XPHB|歷史}、{@skill Investigation|XPHB|調查}、{@skill Nature|XPHB|自然}或{@skill Religion|XPHB|宗教}。若你不熟練所選技能，你獲得其熟練；若你已熟練該技能，你獲得其{@variantrule Expertise|XPHB|專精}。

entries.name: Quick Study
entries: 你可以作為一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}執行{@action Study|XPHB|研究}動作。

feat.name: Keenness of the Stone Giant

feat: strike of the giants|BGG|strike of the giants (stone strike)

entries: You've manifested the physical talents emblematic of stone giants, granting you the following benefits:

items.name: Cavernous Sight
entries: You gain {@sense darkvision} with a range of 60 feet. If you already have {@sense darkvision} from another source, its range increases by 60 feet.

items.name: Stone Throw
entries: As a bonus action, you can take a rock and make a magical attack with it. The attack is a ranged spell attack with a range of 60 feet that uses the ability score you increased with this feat as the spellcasting ability. On a hit, the rock deals {@damage 1d10} force damage, and the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + the spellcasting ability modifier) or have the prone condition. You can use this bonus action a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Knight of the Crown
entries: You are a Knight of Solamnia aligned with the Order of the Crown, a group that extols the virtues of cooperation, loyalty, and obedience. You excel in group combat and gain these benefits:

items.name: Commanding Rally
entries: As a bonus action, you can command one ally within 30 feet of yourself to attack. If that ally can see or hear you, they can immediately make one weapon attack as a reaction. If the attack hits, the ally can roll a {@dice d8} and add the number rolled as a bonus to the attack's damage roll. You can use this bonus action a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Membership in Knightly Orders
entries: Knights of Solamnia are only ever members of one of their organization's orders. In the course of their training, most knights begin as members of the Knights of the Crown and then move on to join other orders. Whether a character follows this path or another, they retain what they learned as a member of an order even if they join another. Characters can change what knightly order they're a part of, but they always have access to any Knight of Solamnia feats they've acquired.

feat.name: Knight of the Rose
entries: You are a Knight of Solamnia aligned with the Order of the Rose, a group known for leadership, justice, and wisdom. Your resolve grants you these benefits:

items.name: Bolstering Rally
entries: As a bonus action, you can encourage one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself (you can choose yourself). If the target can see or hear you, the target gains temporary hit points equal to {@dice 1d8} + your proficiency bonus + the ability modifier of the ability score increased by this feat. You can use this bonus action a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Membership in Knightly Orders
entries: Knights of Solamnia are only ever members of one of their organization's orders. In the course of their training, most knights begin as members of the Knights of the Crown and then move on to join other orders. Whether a character follows this path or another, they retain what they learned as a member of an order even if they join another. Characters can change what knightly order they're a part of, but they always have access to any Knight of Solamnia feats they've acquired.

feat.name: Knight of the Sword
entries: You are a Knight of Solamnia aligned with the Order of the Sword, a group devoted to heroism and courage. Bravery steels your spirit, granting you these benefits:

items.name: Demoralizing Strike
entries: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a weapon attack roll, you can attempt to frighten that target. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat). On a failed save, the target is {@condition frightened} of you until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, the target has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Membership in Knightly Orders
entries: Knights of Solamnia are only ever members of one of their organization's orders. In the course of their training, most knights begin as members of the Knights of the Crown and then move on to join other orders. Whether a character follows this path or another, they retain what they learned as a member of an order even if they join another. Characters can change what knightly order they're a part of, but they always have access to any Knight of Solamnia feats they've acquired.

feat.name: Light Bringer
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Sacred Magic
entries: You learn the {@spell Light|XPHB} spell and can cast it without Material components. If you already know that cantrip, you learn a different Cleric cantrip of your choice. The spell's spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

entries.name: Solar Luminance
entries: When you cast {@spell Light|XPHB}, you can have the light from the spell be sunlight. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Sun's Healing
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} while within sunlight, you can expend one of your {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}, roll the die, and regain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the roll. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Lightly Armored
entries: 你受訓於熟練輕甲的使用方法，你獲得下列好處：

items: 你獲得輕甲的熟練。

feat.name: Lightly Armored
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Armor Training
entries: 你獲得輕型護甲與盾牌的受訓。

feat.name: Linguist
entries: 你致力研究於語言和密碼。獲得下列好處：

items: 你習得三種自選語言。
你能夠巧妙地創造出書寫密碼。其他人無法破譯你創造的密碼，除非你教導他們、他們成功通過一次智力檢定（DC等於你的智力值+你的熟練加值）、或是他們使用魔法破譯。

feat.name: Lordly Resolve
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Standard Bearer
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, choose up to three creatures within 60 feet of yourself that can see you. Each target can immediately take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to right itself and end the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition, provided its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} isn't 0. Additionally, you bolster the targets' resolve, which lasts for 1 minute or until you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. While bolstered, a target can't be possessed or gain the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition; if a target is already possessed, {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, or {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, the target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on any new saving throw against the relevant effect.
Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Lords' Alliance Agent
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Inspiring Strike
entries: Once per turn when you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} against a creature, you can choose an ally within 30 feet of yourself who can see or hear you and who lacks {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}. That ally gains {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}.

entries.name: Reassert Honor
entries: When an enemy you can see deals damage to an ally of yours that is within 5 feet of you, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on your next attack roll against that enemy before the end of your next turn.

feat.name: Love Bites
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Endearing Pain
entries: Immediately after you damage a creature with a Melee weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to give the target the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn or until you or your allies damage it. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Lucky
entries: 你的離奇運氣讓你可以在最危險的時刻化險為夷。
你獲得3點幸運點。當你進行攻擊檢定、屬性檢定、或豁免檢定時，你可以花費一點幸運點以再骰一顆額外的d20。你可以選擇在你擲骰之後，但決定結果之前才花費幸運點。你選擇要使用哪一顆d20以用在該攻擊檢定、屬性檢定、或豁免檢定。
你也可以在一次對你的攻擊檢定被進行時選擇花費一點幸運點。骰一顆d20，然後選擇該次攻擊要使用攻擊者還是你的骰子。如果有超過一個生物花費幸運點以影響一次擲骰的結果，則幸運點將彼此抵消；不需要擲任何額外的骰子。
你在完成一次長休後恢復所有你花費掉的幸運點。

feat.name: Lucky
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Luck Points
entries: 你擁有數量等同於你{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}的幸運點，並可將其花費於下列益處。當你完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時，你會取回已花費的幸運點。

entries.name: Advantage
entries: 當你為一次{@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|d20 檢定}擲 {@dice d20} 時，你可以花費 1 點幸運點，使自己在該擲骰上具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}。

entries.name: Disadvantage
entries: 當一個生物對你進行攻擊檢定而擲 {@dice d20} 時，你可以花費 1 點幸運點，使該擲骰具有{@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB|劣勢}。

feat.name: Mage Slayer
entries: 你精熟於在近身戰鬥中對付施法者的實用技巧，獲得下列好處：

items: 當一個處於你5呎範圍內的生物施展法術，你可以使用你的反應對該生物進行一次近戰武器攻擊。
當你傷害了一個正專注於法術的生物，該生物在維持專注的豁免檢定中獲得劣勢。
你在對抗處於你5呎範圍內的生物所施展的法術時的豁免檢定中獲得優勢。

feat.name: Mage Slayer
entries: 你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Concentration Breaker
entries: 當你對一個正在{@status Concentration|XPHB|專注}的生物造成傷害時，該生物為維持{@status Concentration|XPHB|專注}所進行的豁免檢定具有{@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB|劣勢}。

entries.name: Guarded Mind
entries: 若你在智力、感知或魅力豁免檢定中失敗，你可以改為成功。一旦使用此益處，直到你完成一次{@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|短休}或{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}前都無法再次使用。

feat.name: Magic Initiate
